race_context: The district: Yorktown Community Schools serves the Town of Yorktown and surrounding Mount Pleasant Township in Delaware County, west of Muncie, with four schools: Pleasant View Elementary (K-2), Yorktown Elementary (3-5), Yorktown Middle School (6-8) and Yorktown High School (9-12) {town_schools}. Ballotpedia reports 2,767 students in the 2023-24 school year {bp_yt}. Dr. Greg Hinshaw is superintendent {yt_board}.

The board has five members serving four-year terms {bp_yt}. Members are Ryan Kelly (president), Vici Gasaway (vice president), Jason Brooks (secretary), Ashley Gillespie and Tom Simpson {yt_board}. Because the district covers Mount Pleasant Township, all seats are listed on the ballot as Mt. Pleasant Township seats; Brooks and Gillespie were candidates for the two seats on the 2024 ballot {bp_yt_elections}.

Seats on the 2026 ballot: Ballotpedia lists the race as three seats, so voters may choose up to three, not one as shown on the state list {bp_yt_elections}{in_list}. In 2022 the three at-large seats were held by Ryan Kelly, Pat LaVelle and Tom Simpson, all of whom filed to run again {sp_2022}. Of the members whose seats were not on the 2024 ballot, Kelly is running again; Gasaway and Simpson are not on the 2026 candidate list {yt_board}{in_list}.

Party labels: under the 2025 law that lets school board candidates list a party, two candidates here are listed as Republicans, three as Independents and two as Nonpartisan {in_list}{bp_yt_elections}.

Budget and SEA 1 (2026): the district says SEA 1, the 2025 property-tax law, 'will reduce the funds available to schools over the next several years' for transportation, maintenance, non-certified staff and utilities, and that it staggered school start times for 2026-27 so drivers can run multiple routes and the bus fleet can shrink over time {yt_start_times}.

2027 budget: the board held a hearing Sept. 29, 2026 on the proposed 2027 budget, capital projects plan and bus replacement plan, with adoption set for Oct. 20, 2026 {yt_special_session}{yt_form3}. The published notice lists budget estimates totaling about $37.6 million, including $23 million for the education fund and $10.1 million for operations, and an estimated property tax cap credit of about $1.68 million {yt_form3}.

Teachers (2026): the board scheduled a Sept. 16, 2026 public meeting on a tentative 2026-27 contract with the Yorktown Teachers Association; the posted draft sets a minimum annual teacher salary of $55,000 {yt_teacher_notice}{yt_teacher_ta}. The superintendent said in June 2026 that the district was fully staffed for 2026-27 {wb_staffed}.

Enrollment and transfers: the district accepts transfer students on a space-available basis, with a lottery deadline of May 8, 2026 for grades 1–12 and possible closure of enrollment because of capacity {yt_transfers}.
Facilities: Hinshaw said in August 2026 that recent floods heavily damaged some middle school athletic fields and put water in the basements of two buildings {wb_flood}.
Forums: this guide found no 2026 candidate forum, questionnaire or news coverage of this race.
